items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: I forget this name, I call him Crutcher. Papa Crutcher.

ctx.x: And who was the drummer? Do you know?

The same, I forget this name, I call him Crutcher. Papa Crutcher. His name was. Papa Cripple Crutcher One. Drum. Mm-hmm. Crutcher Cripple One. Crutcher. Papa Crutcher. That's my first, first playing with professionals was Chris Kelly. Yeah.
And then later a little bit was Ridgely.
